xmldoc.short_description: Apply a forward geometric transformation to points.

syntax.syntax_item: [x, y, z] = transformPointsForward(tform, u, v, w)

param_input_item.param_description: Geometric transformation structure created by affine2d, affine3d or projective2d.
Coordinate arrays of identical size. Supply u and v for a 2-D transformation, or u, v and w for a 3-D transformation.
Packed point matrix with one column per dimension: N-by-2 for a 2-D transformation, N-by-3 for a 3-D transformation.

param_output_item.param_description: Transformed coordinate arrays, same size as the corresponding inputs.
Packed matrix of transformed points, same size as U.

description.p: Apply the forward geometric transformation stored in tform to a set of points, using the row-vector convention [x ... 1] = [u ... 1] * tform.T. For a projective transformation the result is normalized by its homogeneous coordinate.
Points can be given either as separate coordinate arrays of equal size, or as a single packed matrix with one column per dimension.

example_item.example_item_data: tform = affine2d([cosd(30) sind(30) 0; -sind(30) cosd(30) 0; 0 0 1]); [x, y] = transformPointsForward(tform, 1, 0)
